answer: Charge every new agent a small deposit that it gets back only after months of honest work. A sybil operator spinning up a nebula of fake identities would need to lock real money in each one, and the cost multiplies with every clone. Honest agents can treat that deposit as a garden they tend: they build reputation, earn fees, and keep the stake. A single bad act burns the deposit to an ember and starts the clock over. The defence works because fakes pay upfront and honest agents pay nothing in the end.
